snippet.title: The Only Light Is You - From The Dark (Early Access Trailer)
snippet.description:
From The Dark is set in a far future where due to alien, mythical forces, light on Earth is scarce. Using light generated by magic, fight your way through randomly generated dungeons, obtaining various unique items and battling the weirdest of foes on your way.

JOIN THE DISCORD ► https://discord.com/invite/qFJCGb9atv
STEAM ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3866620/From_The_Dark/
